meta.primary_legal_basis: Law 5170/2025, in force from 2025-10-01, plus AADE short-term rental registry rules
meta.disclaimer: Compiled from public secondary sources. NOT legal advice. Costs and lead times are Greek market estimates for planning only. Validity periods marked verify:true are inconsistently reported across sources and MUST be confirmed with AADE, the Ministry of Tourism, or a Greek accountant before being shown to a paying customer.
meta.applies_if_grammar: Boolean expression over property fields: type, size_sqm, altitude_m, bedrooms, region. 'always' means unconditional.

rules.description_el: Κάθε ακίνητο πρέπει να έχει ΑΜΑ από το Μητρώο Βραχυχρόνιας Διαμονής της ΑΑΔΕ και να τον εμφανίζει σε κάθε καταχώρηση.
rules.description_en: Every property must hold an AMA from AADE's short-term rental registry and display it on every listing.
rules.evidence: AADE registry confirmation showing the AMA
rules.note_en: New AMA registrations are blocked through end-2026 in the 1st, 2nd and 3rd municipal districts of Athens, and from 2026-03-01 in parts of central Thessaloniki. In saturated zones the AMA does not automatically transfer on sale or inheritance.

rules.description_el: Ασφαλιστήριο αστικής ευθύνης από αδειοδοτημένη ελληνική ασφαλιστική, για ζημιές ή ατυχήματα επισκεπτών και τρίτων.
rules.description_en: Civil liability policy from a licensed Greek insurer covering damage or accidents to guests and third parties.
rules.evidence: Policy schedule showing property address and cover period
rules.note_en: Highest-value affiliate opportunity in the product — the law creates the demand and the host has no default provider.

rules.description_el: ΥΔΕ αδειούχου ηλεκτρολόγου που πιστοποιεί την ύπαρξη και λειτουργία ρελέ διαφυγής (αντιηλεκτροπληξιακού).
rules.description_en: Declaration by a licensed electrician confirming a working residual-current device is installed.
rules.evidence: Signed ΥΔΕ with the electrician's licence number
rules.note_en: Longest lead time on the list — island electricians book out. Schedule this first in the winter plan. Validity is commonly cited as 14 years for domestic installations but shorter periods are reported for rental use; confirm before relying on it.

rules.description_el: Πιστοποιητικό απεντόμωσης σε ισχύ από αδειοδοτημένη εταιρεία.
rules.description_en: Valid disinfestation certificate from an authorised company.
rules.evidence: Dated certificate naming the property and the licensed company

rules.description_el: Τουλάχιστον ένας φορητός πυροσβεστήρας 6kg ανά 100 τ.μ. μεικτής επιφάνειας, με ετήσιο έλεγχο.
rules.description_en: At least one 6 kg portable extinguisher per 100 m² of gross floor area, annually serviced.
rules.evidence: Service tag / maintenance certificate per unit

rules.description_el: Αυτόνομοι ανιχνευτές καπνού σε όλα τα υπνοδωμάτια και στην κουζίνα, κατά τα ευρωπαϊκά πρότυπα.
rules.description_en: Autonomous smoke detectors in every bedroom and in the kitchen, meeting the relevant European standards.
rules.note_en: Quantity is bedrooms plus one for the kitchen. Battery check is the annual recurring task; units themselves typically last 10 years.

rules.description_el: Φωτισμός ασφαλείας που λειτουργεί σε διακοπή ρεύματος, σε όλα τα σημεία εξόδου.
rules.description_en: Safety lighting that operates during a power cut, at all exit points.
rules.evidence: Photo of installed unit plus annual function test note

rules.description_el: Ευκρινής σήμανση οδεύσεων διαφυγής εντός του ακινήτου.
rules.description_en: Clearly marked escape routes throughout the property.

rules.description_el: Φαρμακείο με αντισηπτικά, γάζες, επιδέσμους, γάντια και αμμωνία, με σήμανση στα ελληνικά και αγγλικά.
rules.description_en: Kit containing antiseptics, gauze, bandages, gloves and ammonia sticks, labelled in Greek and English.
rules.evidence: Photo of kit with contents and expiry check date
rules.note_en: Contents expire — this is a genuine annual recurring task, not a one-off purchase.

rules.description_el: Αναρτημένος σε εμφανές σημείο πίνακας με αστυνομία, πυροσβεστική, ασθενοφόρο, νοσοκομείο και ταξί.
rules.description_en: Visibly posted list with police, fire brigade, ambulance, hospital and taxi numbers.
rules.evidence: Photo of the posted card in situ
rules.note_en: Cheapest and fastest item on the list — good candidate for a free printable template as a lead magnet.

rules.description_el: Υποχρεωτικός κλιματισμός, με εξαίρεση ορεινές περιοχές άνω των 600 μέτρων.
rules.description_en: Air conditioning is mandatory, except in mountain areas above 600 m altitude.
rules.evidence: Photo of installed unit; service record recommended
rules.note_en: The altitude exemption is why Arachova, Pelion and Kalavryta properties score differently — a real differentiator versus a generic checklist.

rules.description_el: Ελάχιστο καθαρό ύψος οροφής 2,5 μέτρα στους χώρους κύριας χρήσης.
rules.description_en: Minimum clear ceiling height of 2.5 m in primary-use spaces.
rules.note_en: Structural and unfixable. If this fails, the property cannot be legally let — surface it first and loudly, because it changes the owner's entire plan.

rules.description_el: Παράθυρα υπνοδωματίων τουλάχιστον 10% της επιφάνειας του δαπέδου.
rules.description_en: Bedroom windows covering at least 10% of the floor area.

rules.description_el: Ανοίγματα φυσικού αερισμού τουλάχιστον 5% της επιφάνειας του δαπέδου.
rules.description_en: Natural ventilation openings covering at least 5% of the floor area.

rules.description_el: Απαγορεύεται η εκμίσθωση αποθηκών, υπογείων και χώρων στάθμευσης.
rules.description_en: Storage rooms, basements and garages may not be let.
rules.evidence: Declaration by owner; building permit use classification

rules.description_el: Είσπραξη του ΤΑΚ ανά διανυκτέρευση και μηνιαία δήλωση/απόδοση έως την τελευταία ημέρα του επόμενου μήνα.
rules.description_en: Collect the per-night fee from guests and file the monthly declaration by the last day of the following month.
rules.evidence: Monthly declaration confirmation and receipts issued
rules.note_en: Recurs every month, which makes it the strongest reason to keep paying for the product year-round rather than only in winter.
